# MBH Solutions

> Industrial Automation and Beverage Process Systems. Siemens Integrator Company.

MBH Solutions provides end-to-end PLC and SCADA-based automation solutions for food and beverage, FMCG, power generation, and process manufacturing industries. As a SIEMENS Integrator company, we deliver real-time monitoring and ongoing maintenance support.

We design, fabricate, and install turnkey syrup rooms, CSD and juice process lines, and plant-wide control systems — from new installations to the modernisation and retrofit of existing production facilities.

MBH Solutions is the sole representative in Pakistan of SSP – Stainless Steel Processing GmbH (Bobingen, Germany), its principal for syrup room and beverage process systems.

MBH Solutions supplies central CIP stations and skids (1 to 4 circuits as standard, expandable to 6 or 8), mobile CIP trolleys on demand, and product recovery systems for beverage, dairy and food plants, delivered turnkey or as a retrofit on Siemens S7 / WinCC.
